Ollama local provider routes requests via ollama/ model prefix with no auth

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.chat_async(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'Hello', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'ollama/qwen2:0.5b'))
puts result.choices.inspect
puts result.choices[0].message.content.inspect
puts result.choices[0].finish_reason.inspect
puts result.model.inspect
```
